articles.summary: This is the origin of Re-think, the circular solutions arm of Liberty Blume, part of the Liberty Global family. We’re providing companies with an end-to-end solution for reducing their environmental impact by identifying and reusing customer premise equipment (CPE) and core network infrastructure, connecting sellers with buyers in the wider telco space.
articles.title: Refurbish, Reuse, Re-think: Our entrepreneurial approach to fighting global e-waste
